parsing_traps: NO 'Portfolio Statement' anchor in this report (locate.py found zero hits). Per-property disclosure was reconstructed from: (a) the 'Portfolio Overview' table on p26-27 (NLA, land tenure, property type, WALE, occupancy, GR & NPI in JPY/VND millions) and (b) the individual property factsheets p28-46 ('OUR PROPERTIES': completion date, land tenure, land area, NLA, purchase consideration, valuation, occupancy, WALE). There is no audited per-property table; valuations are from the unaudited factsheets.
Pages 26 and 27 are EXACT DUPLICATES of the Portfolio Overview table (parser artifact). Extracted the 19 properties once.

Dual currency: per-property money figures are JPY (18 Japan properties) and VND (1 Vietnam property), NEVER SGD. currency set per record. Trust-level financials are SGD. Functional & presentation currency of the Trust is SGD (note 2.3, p173); foreign operations' income translated at transaction-date rates, assets/liabilities at reporting-date rate (p173) - so NO single FX rate is disclosed.

Per-property GR/NPI are headlined in JPY millions; 13 of 19 properties suppress GR (single-tenant confidentiality, note 3 p26). Therefore Sigma(property GR) and Sigma(property NPI) CANNOT reconcile to the SGD trust totals - different currency AND incomplete per-property GR.
Top 10 tenants are ranked by % of NPI (footnote 4, p50), NOT by GRI. Stored in gri_percentage field with pct_basis='npi' to flag. Tenants A/B/C (ranks 5,7,9) are anonymised - no consent (footnote 5).

Land tenure appears in two forms: factsheets give full text ('Leasehold expiring in July 2034', 'Freehold') while the Portfolio Overview p26 abbreviates ('Expiring 2034'). Used the factsheet full text for tenure_raw. Six properties are 'Leasehold Properties' where the SPONSOR owns the land leasehold and DHLT holds beneficial interest (p52): DPL Kawasaki Yako, D Project Kuki S, D Project Misato S, DPL Shinfuji, DPL Okayama Hayashima, D Project Fukuoka Tobara S.
D Project Iruma S tenure converted to freehold in 2024 (factsheet note 1, p37); purchase consideration JPY 4,406m is aggregate for property + freehold land (note 2).
DPL Iwakuni 1 & 2 and D Project Matsuyama S / DPL Okayama Hayashima each combine two buildings with different completion dates; effective_date set to the earlier building, both noted.

Distributable income layering: headline/audited 'Income available for distribution' S$30,378k (DPU 4.33c). Distribution Statement also shows 'Amount available for distribution' S$46,925k (incl. S$16,547k opening balance) and net carried forward S$14,893k (p163). Took the headline S$30,378k.
Statics of Unitholdings as-at 12 March 2026 (post-FYE); total unitholders 4,865; issued units 700,739,269 (p205-206).

reconciliation.note: QC gate RECON FAIL is a known false positive: the checker naively sums per-property figures (which are in JPY millions for the 18 Japan properties and VND millions for the 1 Vietnam property) against the SGD trust totals (GR S$57,794k, NPI S$44,199k, audited Statement of Total Return p162). Cross-currency summation is meaningless, and per-property GR is suppressed for 13/19 single-tenanted properties. POSITIVE JPY-only checksum (validates per-property data has no duplicates/omissions): sum of the 18 Japan properties' NPI = JPY 4,789m vs reported Japan Portfolio NPI JPY 4,787m (p53) - reconciles within rounding (+/-2m over 18 rows). Sum of the 7 disclosed Japan GR rows = JPY 4,267m, less than reported Japan GRI JPY 5,586m precisely because the 11 Japan single-tenanted properties suppress GR (note 3, p26) - the gap is the undisclosed single-tenant GR, as expected. Sum of disclosed per-property NPI is partial and would mix JPY+VND. No single FX rate disclosed (income translated at transaction-date rates, p173); only approximate acquisition-date SGD equivalents given (Gunma Fujioka JPY 3,990m approx S$35.4m; Tan Duc 2 VND 483.0bn approx S$25.6m; Ibaraki Yuki JPY 2,640m approx S$23.8m). Investment-properties book value S$835,157k (p182) vs headlined portfolio valuation S$835.2m reconcile.
